title: AID Test Portfolio — Execution Unit
$comment: producer: aid-test-execution-unit.sh (P069 Step 1, wraps aid-job.sh — aid-job.sh itself is never modified); consumers: aid-execution-unit-membership.sh (Step 2, sets membership_verified/membership_binding), aid-test-scheduler.sh (Step 5, reads resource_locks/parallel_eligible), aid-select-tests.sh --emit-units (Step 9, produces this shape).
description: One schedulable unit of test execution. unit_id always references a P066 run_units[].run_unit_id directly — this schema never mints a competing identity. command is P066's exact discriminated union (test-catalog.schema.json #/$defs/command, duplicated here verbatim since no cross-file $ref resolver is wired into this repo's python3+jsonschema validation idiom) and is never redefined by this plan.

unit_id.description: MUST equal a P066 run_units[].run_unit_id — never a separately-derived identity.

deadline_seconds.description: Hard wall-clock deadline passed to `aid-job.sh run --deadline`. A unit that exceeds this reaches state:timed_out, never running-forever.

resource_locks.description: Lock names MUST match execution.yaml's test_audit.scheduler.resource_locks — the resolved authority. NEVER read from test-audit.yaml.

parallel_eligible.description: Derived from the catalog's parallel.status (see Step 5's effective-status resolution, which may override this via an approved scheduler-parallel-overlay entry).

membership_verified.description: false until Step 2's membership-verification pass resolves this unit_id to exactly one execution unit and stamps membership_binding.

dedup.description: true ONLY when Step 2 resolves multiple matching commands for the same unit_id under an explicit recommendation:merge precondition. Never set by this step.

membership_binding.description: Populated only by Step 2. Absent/null here in Step 1's own output — Step 5 rejects any unit with membership_verified false/absent OR a stale membership_binding.catalog_fingerprint.
